evals.prompt: The analytics page needs a monthly revenue line chart (filled area) with a KPI row above it showing total revenue and active users. Data comes from our API as plain numbers.
evals.expected_output: A page that imports the pre-built ChartWrapper and MetricCard, builds the ChartData with cssVar()/cssVarAlpha() from ~/utils/chartColors, and gives the wrapping card a fixed height (e.g. h-72) rather than the chart itself.
assertions: Imports ChartWrapper from ~/components/shared/ChartWrapper.vue instead of constructing a Chart.js canvas
Dataset colours come from cssVar()/cssVarAlpha() imported from ~/utils/chartColors
The height class (e.g. h-72) is on the wrapping div, not on ChartWrapper
The line dataset uses fill: true with cssVarAlpha('--primary', 0.15) as backgroundColor
The KPI row uses the pre-built MetricCard rather than a hand-rolled stat card

evals.prompt: Show our sales pipeline stages as a doughnut chart next to the deals table. Sometimes the stage breakdown comes back empty for new accounts.
evals.expected_output: A doughnut ChartWrapper with slice colours from the --chart-1..--chart-5 tokens via cssVar(), sized by its wrapper card, with the empty case left to ChartWrapper's built-in state machine.
assertions: Slice colours use cssVar('--chart-1'), cssVar('--chart-2'), etc. — no hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl
Does not append an alpha suffix by string concatenation (no cssVar('--primary') + '20')
Does not add custom empty-state markup inside ChartWrapper; the built-in states handle it
The wrapper card controls the height

evals.prompt: I want one chart comparing monthly revenue (thousands) with refunds (tens). Right now when I tried it the refunds line was flat on the bottom.
evals.expected_output: Two series with strongly different magnitudes given separate y-axes (yAxisID 'y1' plus a matching scales.y1 entry positioned right with grid.drawOnChartArea false), or split into two charts — never shared onto one axis.
assertions: The refunds series does not share the primary y-axis with revenue
Either a second axis (yAxisID + scales.y1, position right, grid.drawOnChartArea false) or two separate charts is used
No legend entry is rendered for a series that is invisible on the chart
